summary: Commit 566b7302. features/supervision.feature: added r214, r215, r216; r28 scenario deprecated for removal. features bindings: every binding names a scenario. model check: 83 violations, 13 warnings (r217 v_s3 expected; others pre-existing). r217 returned as a question.
questions: r217: "**If** the main checkout's `.shop/work/`, less each path under `.shop/work/<initiative>/` of another initiative, differs from its last commit when a worker ends, then `work run` shall put it back and transition the work-item to `failed`, naming each file." Reading 1: "another initiative" is any initiative other than the work-item's, so under `work run i1` alone an uncommitted change to `.shop/work/i2/` is left alone and w1 does not fail. Reading 2: "another initiative" is, as in r214 to r216, one that `work run` is running side by side, so under `work run i1` alone such a change is put back and w1 is failed, naming it.
